text: FIX two different databases shared one physical store in the Dexie.js, localStorage, and memory RxStorage when a database name or collection name contained the separator that the storage uses to join the database name, the collection name, and the schema version (for example database `app--staging` with collection `todos` and database `app` with collection `staging--todos` in the localStorage RxStorage). Such names now get an unambiguous store name. Note: The store name stays the same for all other names. Only these existing stores get a new name, so their previously stored data is no longer found: Dexie.js stores of a database whose name contains `--`, and localStorage stores where the database name or the collection name contains `--` or the collection name starts with `-`
